lines.en: I creep over on quiet feet.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看你的口袋。
lines.en: I walk while eyeing your pockets.
I move low and quick through the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕过村子，从边上过去。
lines.en: I go around the village by the edge.

lines.zh: 我的脚步落在土上没声。
lines.en: My steps on the dirt make no sound.

lines.zh: 我贴着篱笆走，袋子压着腰。
lines.en: I walk along the fence, the bag pressing my hip.
Every two steps I crouch.
My bag swings at my hip.
I walk along the base of the fence.

lines.zh: 我朝有东西反光的地方走。
lines.en: I head toward the glint of something.

lines.zh: 我每走一步都先落脚尖
lines.en: I set down each step toe-first.

lines.zh: 我先绕到上风处再靠近
lines.en: I circle upwind before closing in.
I crouch and count your belongings.

lines.zh: 平原上我一边走，一边摸你的口袋。
lines.en: On the plains, I walk and pick your pockets.
I wait for you to show your back.

lines.zh: 我把手伸进袋子摸了摸。
lines.en: I reach into my bag and feel around.
I listen for anyone coming.
I press to the wall, not even breathing.

lines.zh: 我把一颗扣子翻来翻去。
lines.en: I turn a button over in my fingers.

lines.zh: 我在看你的腰上挂什么。
lines.en: I am looking at what hangs at your waist.
I have a knife hidden in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的手指很灵活，一直动。
lines.en: My fingers are nimble and never still.
You have quite a lot on you.
I do not hurt people; I only take things.
Just turn away for a moment.
I look up at you with a false smile.
Your hand never leaves your bag.
Let us talk; no need to fight.
That at your waist, is it worth much?
I am only passing through.
Your footsteps are very loud.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我就不好下手。
lines.en: With you watching, I cannot work.
I curse and retreat.

lines.zh: 我捂着被打的地方，缩起来。
lines.en: I cover the spot and shrink down.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了我的重心。
lines.en: That knocked my balance askew.

lines.zh: 我笑着退，眼睛还在看袋子。
lines.en: I retreat smiling, still eyeing the bag.

lines.zh: 偷来的胡萝卜掉了一根。
lines.en: A stolen carrot dropped.
I crouch low and shield my loot.

lines.zh: 这一刀擦着我的肋过去了。
lines.en: That blade skinned past my ribs.
I drag myself back to the wall.
That cut goes on the account.
I do not shout; that makes it worse.
That shiny thing, I saw it.
Set your pack down a moment.
What is in that bag?
You hang your things too far out.
Iron things I like even better.
The moment your hand slackens, I take it.
It would be better if you slept.
You smell of something good.
That blade is worth a few coins.
The clasp at your waist is loose.
You bump me and I retreat at once.

lines.zh: 我的手在你腰边滑过去。
lines.en: My hand slides past your waist.
We collide and I pretend to fall.
You shove me into the fence.
I press close and my hand finds it.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我叫了一声。
lines.en: You step on my foot and I yelp.

lines.zh: 分开时，我手上多了点东西。
lines.en: As we part, I have something new in hand.
I step back with a smile and a wave.

lines.zh: 你抓我袖子，我脱了外套。
lines.en: You grab my sleeve and I slip out of the coat.

lines.zh: 我绕你一圈，又撞了一次。
lines.en: I circle you and bump again.
I only want to take things.
Show me your pockets first.
That is a poor bargain.
I wave a hand and back away.
This is not the right moment.
I hide my hands in my sleeves.
I smile and do not agree.
I work alone.
I have not finished taking your things.
I back away while fingering your pouch.
I pick it up and slip it into my sleeve.
One flick of my fingers and it is mine.
What falls is not stealing.
I toss it twice; it has weight.
This will fetch a price.
I pick it up and put it back where it was.
I bury it at the bottom of my bag.
My hands are never empty.
This is too small to hide.
I pick it up while listening for noise.
I have put you on my list.
This one has things on him.
I work my way around you.
I fix on the bulge at your waist.
I keep the mark in mind.
The target is your bag.
I am fixed on it, unblinking.

lines.zh: 我贴着草丛挪到你侧面
lines.en: I creep through the grass to your flank.
This one is wary; I must wait.
I raise a hand and point at your waist.

lines.zh: 你转身时是最好的时机。
lines.en: When you turn is the best moment.
I start reaching for the bag.
I am not switching; I want yours.
I have the place noted.
Just stand there and do not look back.
A small job, but enough.
My bow's already drawn.

lines.zh: 我数着你口袋晃动的次数。
lines.en: I count the swings of your pocket.
I trail you the whole way.
You take three steps; so do I.
I wait behind the fence.

lines.zh: 你的手一离开袋子，我就动。
lines.en: The moment your hand leaves the bag, I move.
I follow along the wall base.
You look back, and I am studying the sky.
No hurry; I will wait for dark.
The tenser you get, the more openings I see.
I move to your blind side.
I work inward inch by inch.
I have your footsteps memorised.
I know these paths better than you.
I crouch at the corner, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我就看清了。
lines.en: You lift the thing, and I see it clearly.
I work along the wall toward you.

lines.zh: 你听见的响动，其实是猫。
lines.en: That noise you hear is really a cat.
I circle halfway and come back.

lines.zh: 你把袋子换到另一边，我也换。
lines.en: You shift the bag to the other side; so do I.
I wait for you to push the door open.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直在你腰上。
lines.en: My eyes never leave your waist.

lines.zh: 我推你一下，趁机摸袋子。
lines.en: I shove you once and grope for the bag.
I tap your wrist with the flat of my blade.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了让你松手。
lines.en: That was to make you let go.

lines.zh: 撞一下就撤，这是我的规矩。
lines.en: Hit once and withdraw — that's my rule.
I grab your belt and pull.
A dirty strike, and a quick one.
You blocked; I came from below.
I strike your hand and the thing drops.

lines.zh: 我一脚扫你脚踝，手伸向腰
lines.en: I sweep your ankle and reach for your belt.
I used your own weight for that.
I reach out and pull at your bag.
One shoulder butt and you veer off.
I press your hand down.

lines.zh: 这一下我挑了关节下手。
lines.en: I aimed that at a joint.
I shove you from behind.
I grip the edge of your pocket.
One pull and you spin half around.
I slap the back of your hand, sharply.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，我只要速度。
lines.en: Not heavy; I only need speed.
I strike while backing away.
I poke my head out from behind the fence.

lines.zh: 草动了一下，我蹲在那儿。
lines.en: The grass stirs; I am crouched there.
I toss a small pebble first.
I slide down from the roof edge.
I edge out along the wall.
You hear a quiet laugh.
I drop in, feet first.
I come round from behind you to the side.
I crouch in the doorway.
I scouted this area yesterday.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里冒出半个身子。
lines.en: Half of me rises out of the grass.
I pull my hat low and walk over.
Fire catches my bag and I beat at it.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶滑下，摔得滚了一圈。
lines.en: I slide off the roof and roll.

lines.zh: 水一口口灌，我乱抓岸边。
lines.en: Water pours in and I claw at the bank.
The blast slaps me into the fence.
The arrow pinned my sleeve to the wall.

lines.zh: 法术扫过，我的手脚都慢了。
lines.en: A spell passes and my limbs slow.

lines.zh: 两天没吃到东西，腿发虚。
lines.en: Two days without food and my legs feel hollow.
Lightning strikes and I flatten to the ground.

lines.zh: 虚空拽我，我抓着篱笆桩。
lines.en: The void pulls and I grip a fence post.
